owner_decision: 2026-11-20: no MaxMind/GeoLite2 data (CC BY-SA 4.0 declined). Consume public operator RFC 8805 geofeeds only, per-operator with attribution, shown as-is, with a takedown/deny list. No licensed database is used or redistributed. The derived table is display-only and never feeds the relay chooser or the ranking.

method: HTTP GET with a descriptive User-Agent (LightSpeed-geofeed-diligence/1.0); robots.txt checked on every feed host (none disallows the feed paths; JSON API hosts have no robots file).
RFC 8805 five-column parse with the same parser the build uses: prefix,country,region,city,postal; malformed/cityless/IPv6 rows counted, not trusted.

RIR declaration: RIPE RDAP geofeed link relation (RFC 9632, rdapConformance geofeed1) or the RIPE inetnum geofeed: attribute via the RIPE Stat whois data call; ARIN RDAP 'Geofeed <url>' remarks for ARIN-registered space.
Coverage spot-check: the feed's IPv4 ranges are compared with RIPE Stat announced-prefixes for the operator's ASN (prefix count and address-weighted overlap).
A sample address per source is re-resolved through the committed blob after the build (see wat/evidence for the run log).
verification.rfc9632_note: RFC 9632 'Finding and Using Geofeed Data' defines discovery through the RPSL inetnum/inet6num geofeed attribute and the RDAP link relation rel=geofeed (plus an optional RPKI signed geofeed object). It defines no DNS geofeed record; its only DNS mention is that other geographic hints (DNS geoloc RRsets, country:, geoloc:) are to be ignored when geofeed data exist. There is therefore no 'RFC 9632 DNS record' to query; the RIR attribute / RDAP link is the authoritative declaration used here.
verification.as_of_rule: A source's as-of is the feed's own generation or last-update statement when it has one (G-Core header, Vultr/Linode headers, HTTP Last-Modified preserved on the local copy); otherwise it is the local copy's UTC fetch date. The build records the exact local hash and timestamps in client/data/server-geofeed.sources.json.

verified.note: The committed table is built from the verified 2026-11-19 snapshot (sha256 a5fdac6f...; header '#AS199524 Geofeed. Was generated at 2026-11-19 00:00:27 UTC'). The live URL was re-fetched on 2026-11-20, when it served the next daily regeneration (sha256 985b850a...): every data row is byte-identical to the snapshot and only the generated-at header line differs, so refreshing would move the label date without changing the table. Feed regenerated daily at 00:00 UTC.

rejected.name: OVH
rejected.reason: No operator-owned RFC 8805 geofeed found. RIPE RDAP whois on sampled OVH inetnums (51.38.0.0/16, 137.74.0.0/16, 2.26.0.0/15) shows no geofeed attribute on OVH's own object; the only geofeed attributes on OVH-announced space are on customer sub-allocations (IPXO, server.pro, goodtec.lv, Acedatacenter) that cover those customers' /24s. Adding them under OVH would misattribute customer space.

rejected.name: Leaseweb
rejected.reason: No operator-owned RFC 8805 geofeed found. RIPE RDAP whois on sampled AS28753 inetnums shows geofeed attributes only on customer sub-allocations (IPXO, Rustelekom/Gtelcom, DNS Protection, Aventice), not on Leaseweb's own objects. AS16265 (Leaseweb Netherlands) was not found to publish a feed either.

Oracle publishes the cloud public-IP JSON feed (public_ip_ranges.json, 57 regions) but that is a cloud region list, not an RFC 8805 operator geofeed.
